requirement.what: A read credential for the governed Canonical Gold and Traffic Insights documents.
requirement.where: https://traffic.goodflippindesign.com/gold/ (admin-gated by design; the documents are produced daily by the Traffic Intelligence pipeline).

insights.reason: No Gold document was read, so no insights document is consulted.

classification.note: Cloudflare zone analytics count requests, not people. No connected source separates certified humans, likely humans or automated agents, so all measured traffic is reported as unclassified edge requests.
